## Strategist
Recommendation: add Lethal Scheme. Cut Boros Charm, not Olivia; if the Charm stays, cut Olivia. Argument unless marked evidence; no goldfish.
1. Removal is the next binding axis, but 8-10 does not transfer: Walser's baseline (strategy:deckbuilding.interaction-suite) assumes only 2-3 resolve; Hinds says derive counts from the deck's failure modes (strategy:deckbuilding.ratios); linear decks win on speed, redundancy, resilience (strategy:critical-mass). Evidence: log 002 tagged interaction-stranded. Aim ~7 true instant-speed answers, not 10.
2. Olivia is not the weakest slot: Vampire flyer, pings at a distance, steals (two of four words), works without Edgar. Costs real ({1}{R} pings, {3}{B}{B} steal). Weakest alternative: Boros Charm (indestructible duplicates Concealment/Teferi's; 4 to one player; no draw, no drain, not a Vampire). Anje, Bastion, Diabolic Intent are not cuts.
3. Scheme over Damn (sorcery, 2WW overload), Winds (sorcery, six-mana overload), Dust (exiles our engine). Scheme misses Purphoros-as-enchantment; Unmaking and Verse cover that.
4. Connive is minor value: a loot per convoker serves the draw axis; counters take 1/1 tokens out of Skullclamp reach — an edge cost.
5. If removal is not binding: Pact of the Serpent, then Sanctum Seeker; Throne/Idol/Champion lower.
Open: companion lacks removal-count norms for linear drain decks and convoke timing (/research-strategy topics).

## Rules-question (Lethal Scheme convoked by four eminence tokens)
(a) Four SEPARATE draw-then-discard sequences in order (701.50c, 701.50a; ruling 2022-04-29). One-card hand: 4 drawn, 4 discarded, up to 4 counters; the hand never empties. Max four convokers (ruling 2022-04-29).
(b) A tapped convoker still connives (702.51c; connive has no untapped requirement). A convoker that left the battlefield still connives, no counter placed (ruling 2022-04-29; 701.50b).
(c) Summoning-sick tokens can convoke (702.51a; ruling 2024-01-12; 302.6 does not reach convoke).
(d) 2/2 token + Skullclamp = 3/1, lives (704.5f fires only at toughness ≤0; 613.4c both effects layer 7c, additive).
(e) Bloodghast returning by landfall triggers Wispdrinker and Welcoming Vampire (603.6a; rulings check power on entry) IF its power is 2 (DB output lacked P/T; printed 2/1). Eminence does NOT trigger: returning is not casting (701.5a; Edgar ruling 2025-01-24).
(f) Planeswalker vs creature target changes nothing for convoke or connive (701.8a/b); Skullclamp draws only on "equipped creature dies".

Asked: with cards 1-3 in (Black Market Connections, Malakir Bloodwitch, Clever Concealment), is Lethal Scheme for Olivia Voldaren the right fourth card, and is Olivia the right cut. Yes on the add, and the cut is right but painful. Removal is the axis left under target that one card moves: the branch's honest single-target count is 6 spells (Anguished Unmaking, Swords to Plowshares, Vanishing Verse, Crackling Doom, plus Toxic Deluge and The Meathook Massacre) against Walser's 8-10, the pod's three kill-on-sight commanders (the seat notes, the pilot's calls of 2026-11-10) are Krenko, Tannuk and Purphoros, and the two that are creatures have a one-turn window, and log 002's structural finding still stands: the mana is spent on Vampires, so there is never open mana to hold up. Of the four removal candidates on the pilot's list (Damn, Winds of Abandon, Everything Comes to Dust, Lethal Scheme) two convoke, and Scheme is the one that does so without exiling the branch's own engine — four eminence tokens cast it at instant speed, in the opponent's upkeep, for zero mana — and it is a third hard answer to a planeswalker beside Anguished Unmaking and the monocolored-only Vanishing Verse (14 walkers across 13 of the 22 stand-in seats). What it does not do, said plainly: it never touches Purphoros (not a creature under five devotion; indestructible when it is), so log 005's 'white disruption for Purphoros' ask stays open at two answers (Unmaking, Verse). Olivia is the cut because her removal is the most expensive per point on the branch — {1}{R} per point of damage, red on every activation in the colour the branch's lands support least (18 red land sources against a 22 target; B 30/36, W 21/22) — and because of the pilot's four words she carries distance and ferocity but neither drain nor gain; the taxonomy files her as a body with counters, not as removal. The cost is real and is stated in cut_candidates: she is the branch's only repeatable creature ping and its only steal, and a ping that kills an X/1 is a death Blood Artist, Falkenrath Noble and Meathook pay on. If the pilot weighs the empty hand by turn eight (logs 002, 003, 006) above the pod's kill-on-sight creatures, the card is Pact of the Serpent (rank 2), not a removal spell at all. Draw check, the pilot's required axis: Olivia draws nothing, so the swap lowers no draw; Scheme's connive is selection, not advantage. No goldfish figure appears here, by the pilot's ruling.
